units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13">Gen. R. s. 13</cite> <he>כמין ת׳</he> (‘Rashi’: <he>כהדין ת׳</he>; ed. Leips. <he>תווין</he>, corr. acc.) as from an overflowing river; <he>נהר בבבל ושמו ת׳ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="B00061"><he>בבל</he></cite>) there is a river (or canal) in Babylonia which is named Tuvay, and why is it named T.? Because it comes back and inundates once in forty years; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:7">Koh. R. to I, 7</cite> <cite ref="V00172"><he>תווהא</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
